name: – Nacho Sánchez Amor – After § 5 – Am 34
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Türkiye
part_text: 5a. Stresses that, given that Türkiye’s accession negotiations have remained at a standstill, Türkiye should no longer receive financial assistance under the Instrument for Pre-Accession Assistance (IPA III); insists that any remaining EU funding to Türkiye must remain fully transparent, strictly conditional and subject to rigorous parliamentary scrutiny;
